_meta.data_freshness: Core e-Visa and visa-exemption facts verified through June 2026; future-dated or implementation-specific items should be rechecked against evisa.gov.vn and primary legal sources before legal/compliance use.

verified_facts: From 15 Aug 2023, citizens of all countries and territories can apply for Vietnam e-visas.
Vietnam e-visas are valid up to 90 days and may be multiple-entry.
VNTA listed 13 airports, 16 land gates, and 13 sea gates in its 2023 guide; newer port expansions should be verified at evisa.gov.vn.
Resolution 229/NQ-CP dated 11 Aug 2025 grants a tourism-purpose visa exemption to citizens of 12 countries.
Eligible visitors may stay up to 45 days from entry.
The program runs from 15 Aug 2025 through 14 Aug 2028.
Resolution 11/NQ-CP for Poland, Czech Republic, and Switzerland ceased to apply from 15 Aug 2025.

use_for: cross-check country tables only; do not treat as primary authority

agent_usage_notes: All durations are in calendar days unless noted.
TIER is a classification field added for agent logic: use it to quickly branch on policy category.
All fees are in USD unless noted.
Fields marked nullable may be null if data is not applicable.
Policies change frequently; always cross-check with evisa.gov.vn for live data.
Do not infer that a country is visa-exempt merely because it is high-traffic or in ASEAN-adjacent travel discourse; only the visa_exemption_by_country table grants visa-free ordinary-passport access.

policy_framework.governing_law: Law on Entry, Exit, Transit, and Residence of Foreigners in Vietnam (No. 47/2014/QH13, amended 2019)
policy_framework.administering_body: Vietnam Immigration Department, Ministry of Public Security
policy_framework.entry_requirement_summary: All foreign nationals require a valid entry permission to enter Vietnam. This is satisfied by one of: (1) visa exemption by nationality, (2) e-Visa, (3) visa on arrival (VOA) with pre-approval letter, or (4) embassy/consulate visa. Phu Quoc Island has a standalone special exemption for all nationalities.
policy_framework.proof_of_onward_travel: May be requested at immigration at discretion of officer; recommended to carry.

VISA_FREE.label: Visa Exemption
VISA_FREE.description: Nationals of qualifying countries may enter without any visa document for tourism, transit, or short visits.
VISA_FREE.re_entry_restriction: No minimum wait time between re-entries under the standard exemption.
VISA_FREE.overstay_consequences: Fines and potential deportation or future entry ban.

EVISA.label: Electronic Visa (e-Visa)
EVISA.description: Available to ALL nationalities. Applied online via evisa.gov.vn. Valid for single or multiple entry, up to 90 days.
EVISA.processing_days: 2-3 business days (expedited options available at higher cost)
EVISA.entry_port_restriction: e-Visa does NOT restrict entry to a single nominated port. Holder may use any approved e-Visa port listed by the official portal. This dataset tracks an 83-port expansion claim; verify the live port list at evisa.gov.vn before travel.

VISA_ON_ARRIVAL.label: Visa on Arrival (with pre-approval letter)
VISA_ON_ARRIVAL.description: Requires a pre-approval letter obtained through a licensed Vietnamese travel agency BEFORE travel. Visa is stamped at designated international airports on arrival.
airports_supporting_voa: Tan Son Nhat International Airport (SGN) - Ho Chi Minh City
Cam Ranh International Airport (CXR) - Nha Trang
VISA_ON_ARRIVAL.notes: Chinese nationals CANNOT use VOA; must obtain visa from Vietnamese embassy in China before travel. VOA has largely been superseded by the e-Visa system.

EMBASSY_VISA.label: Embassy / Consulate Visa
EMBASSY_VISA.description: Traditional visa obtained at Vietnamese diplomatic missions abroad. Used for special visa types (work, study, long-term residence) or where e-Visa is insufficient.

SPECIAL_ZONE_EXEMPTION.label: Phu Quoc Island Special Exemption
SPECIAL_ZONE_EXEMPTION.description: ALL foreign nationals arriving directly to Phu Quoc by air or sea from outside Vietnam may stay on the island for up to 30 days without any visa.
SPECIAL_ZONE_EXEMPTION.restriction: Visitor must remain on Phu Quoc Island; travel to mainland Vietnam voids exemption and requires a separate visa.

abtc_holders.description: APEC Business Travel Card (ABTC) holders with 'VNM' on the card back may enter visa-free for business for up to 60 days.

certificate_of_visa_exemption.description: Special certificate for overseas Vietnamese (Viet Kieu), their spouses, and children under 18.
certificate_of_visa_exemption.re_entry_restriction: None - unlimited entries; no minimum wait time between 180-day periods.

diplomatic_service_passports.description: Holders of diplomatic or official/service passports receive separate, often longer, visa-free periods.
diplomatic_service_passports.note: Varies by bilateral agreement; up to 90 days for many countries. Consult the full diplomatic table at the Vietnam MFA.

china_cuba_north_korea_public_affairs.description: Citizens of China, Cuba, and North Korea holding passports endorsed 'for public affairs' or official public affairs passports may enter visa-free.
china_cuba_north_korea_public_affairs.conditions: Passport must be specifically endorsed for public affairs

priority_foreign_visitor_card.description: Special visa exemption card for foreign nationals in categories prioritized for Vietnam's socio-economic development under Decree 221/2025/ND-CP, effective 15 Aug 2025.
priority_foreign_visitor_card.validity_condition: Validity must be at least 30 days shorter than the passport's remaining validity.
eligible_groups: Official guests of top Vietnamese leaders
Academics, experts, scientists, professors, chief architects, and highly skilled digital technology professionals
Investors, corporate leaders, and executives of major global enterprises
Figures in culture, arts, sports, and tourism with positive public influence
Invited guests of recognized research institutes, universities, and large enterprises approved by competent agencies
Other special cases decided by the Minister of Public Security on recommendation from relevant agencies or organizations

long_term_visa_categories._note: Vietnam does not yet have a formal 'golden visa' but reforms are in progress as of 2025-2026.

decision_logic.description: Pseudocode for AI agents to determine a traveler's entry pathway given nationality and purpose.
pseudocode: RETURN 'CERTIFICATE_VISA_EXEMPTION' // Applies to Viet Kieu and family
IF has_abtc AND purpose == 'BUSINESS' AND duration_days <= 60:
IF entry.valid_until IS NOT NULL AND TODAY > entry.valid_until:
BREAK // Nationality qualifies for exemption but trip too long -> needs e-Visa
RETURN 'EVISA' WITH max_stay=90, cost_usd=50 // multiple-entry recommended
RETURN 'EMBASSY_VISA' // Long-stay requires appropriate visa category

can_US_citizens_enter_visa_free.reason: The United States is NOT on Vietnam's visa exemption list. US nationals must obtain an e-Visa ($25 single entry / $50 multiple entry, up to 90 days) or a consular visa. Do NOT state that Americans get 45-day visa-free entry — this is false.

can_Chinese_nationals_use_VOA.reason: Chinese nationals are excluded from the visa on arrival process. This does not remove the general all-nationalities e-Visa pathway for short stays; use a consular visa when e-Visa is insufficient for the purpose or duration.
can_Chinese_nationals_use_VOA.recommended_pathway: EVISA for eligible short stays; EMBASSY_VISA where e-Visa is insufficient

is_there_a_minimum_wait_between_re_entri.reason: Vietnam does not impose a minimum waiting period between re-entries for visa-exempt travelers. They may exit and immediately re-enter within their permitted stay duration.

can_evisa_holders_enter_by_land.reason: e-Visa holders may enter via approved land borders listed by the official e-Visa portal. This dataset tracks an 83-port expansion claim; verify the live port list before travel.

does_evisa_require_single_entry_port.reason: As of 2025, the e-Visa does not restrict the holder to a single nominated entry port.

what_is_the_phu_quoc_exemption.answer: ALL nationalities may enter Phu Quoc Island directly (by air or sea from outside Vietnam) and stay up to 30 days without any visa. Traveling to mainland Vietnam requires a visa.

what_visa_do_web3_founders_or_investors_.answer: Short stays under 90 days: e-Visa (USD 50, multiple entry). For longer residency: DT (Investment) visa or the upcoming UD1 visa (effective July 2026). Investors from top-100 global firms by market cap may qualify for the UD1 or the proposed Golden Visa under current draft legislation.
what_visa_do_web3_founders_or_investors_.recommended_pathway: EVISA for short stays; EMBASSY_VISA (DT category) or UD1 from July 2026 for long-term

what_is_the_priority_foreign_visitor_car.answer: A special visa exemption card under Decree 221/2025/ND-CP for official guests, selected experts, high-skill digital technology professionals, investors/executives, and other approved priority visitors. It can allow multiple entries for up to five years, subject to approval and passport-validity limits.

key_policy_timeline.event: e-Visa expanded to ALL nationalities; max stay extended from 30 to 90 days; visa-free extended to 45 days for 13 key markets
Resolution 11/NQ-CP: 45-day conditional exemption for Poland, Czech Republic, Switzerland (tour packages only)
Vietnam-Belarus bilateral mutual visa exemption effective: 30 days per entry, max 90 days/year for ordinary passport holders
Visa-free extensions confirmed until 2028 for Germany, France, Italy, Spain, UK, Russia, Japan, South Korea, Denmark, Sweden, Norway, Finland

Resolution 229/NQ-CP: 45-day visa-free for 12 additional European countries (Belgium, Bulgaria, Croatia, Czech Republic, Switzerland, Luxembourg, Hungary, Netherlands, Poland, Romania, Slovakia, Slovenia) until Aug 14, 2028
Resolution 389/NQ-CP: 41 new international border gates added for e-Visa entry/exit, expanding total approved ports from 42 to 83 (4 airports, 11 land borders, 26 seaports)
Announcement: UD1 and UD2 visa categories for high-skill professionals and dependents (valid up to 5 years) to launch July 1, 2026
